sentence: Erratic torque 16–20 kft·lbf while reaming tight spot at 3,215 m; back-reamed one stand and increased flow 10%.
Seepage losses 2–3 bbl/hr at 2,9O5 m in Tipam sand; added fine CaCO₃ to active system and continued drilling.
Overpull 20 klbf at 2,410 m while pulling out; wiped through, hole free.
Top of cement on 9⅝" casing 80 m below plan; accepted without remedial work.
Torque spikes to 22 kft·lbf at 3,480 m in Barail shale; reduced WOB and back-reamed.
Gas peak 11% at 3,390 m after trip (trip gas); no pit gain, MW unchanged.
